title: BioVarFlow parameters
description: A germline variant-calling workflow with standardized QC, annotation, and per-sample reports.

input.title: Samplesheet CSV
input.description: CSV file for variant calling input (required).

outdir.title: Output directory
outdir.description: Where to write results (local path or gs://).

phenotypes.title: Phenotypes CSV (Exomiser)
phenotypes.description: CSV of HPO terms per sample, used by Exomiser to rank variants genome-wide. Columns: sample,sex,hpo - sex is MALE / FEMALE / UNKNOWN_SEX, hpo is a semicolon-separated list of HPO IDs (e.g. IQMM,MALE,HP:0004808;HP:0002863). Exomiser is skipped for any sample not listed.

run_id.title: Run identifier
run_id.description: Identifier for this pipeline run. Written into the first column of ${outdir}/manifest/run_output_manifest.tsv. If omitted, Nextflow's auto-generated workflow.runName is used.

cnv_options.title: CNV calling
cnv_options.description: CNV calling runs as part of the standard germline pipeline. Its inputs are this project's panel of normals and the common-CNV BED delivered with it; the capture kit BED, gene panel and annotation resources are fixed in nextflow.config. Without a panel of normals, CNV calling is skipped and the rest of the run is unaffected. See docs/cnv.md.

cnv_pon.title: Panel of normals (CNVkit reference .cnn)
cnv_pon.description: CNVkit reference built from this project's own normals, delivered by the customer or a separate PoN pipeline. It must be built from the same capture kit BED the project runs on, which the pipeline checks before using it. Leave empty to skip CNV calling.

cnv_common_bed.title: Common CNV regions (common_cnv.bed)
cnv_common_bed.description: The common_cnv.bed that ships with the panel of normals, listing cohort-recurrent CNV regions. Part of the PoN delivery, not an independent input: supply the one built alongside cnv_pon, never a BED from a different PoN. Without it, cohort-recurrent artifacts are not recognised and reach Tier 1 and Tier 2.

cnv_pon_manifest.title: PoN manifest (manifest.json)
cnv_pon_manifest.description: The manifest.json from the cnv_normal PoN build. Leave empty to look for manifest.json next to cnv_pon, which is where a PoN delivery puts it. It records the target BED's md5, the cnvkit version, the reference sex model and each PoN's normals; the run stops if the target BED or the sex model disagrees, since either silently corrupts copy numbers.
